content.short: Serpentor is open-source Vyper on-chain voting and governance smart contracts.
content.description: This project contains two Vyper smart contracts that illustrate how voting and time-lock mechanisms can be implemented on-chain using the Vyper language. By examining the code, developers gain hands-on experience in building governance capabilities and understanding on-chain voting workflows and access control for delayed execution. The codebase shows an active commit history and is maintained by a small team of two contributors, reflecting ongoing maintenance and improvements.
